full_judgment: AK Badrul Huq J: This appeal by the Defendant Nos. 6-9 has been presented challenging the propriety of the judgment and decree dated February 28, 1991 passed by the Second Court of the Subordinate Judge, Chittagong by which the learned Judge awarded decree in favour of the plaintiff in a suit for declaration of exclusive right, title and interest in the suit properties mentioned in Schedule-1 and for further declaration that the suit properties under the provisions of law does not come within the purview of Vested and Non-Resident Properties and also for a decree that the defendant Nos. 1-5 be evicted from the Schedule 1(A), 1(B), 1(C), 1(D) properties respectively and the same be given to the plaintiffs khas possession.
